title: Covenant Logistics Activates Foreign-Trade Zone at Atlanta-Area Distribution Center
summary: Newly active FTZ status in Forest Park, Georgia warehouse with 175,000 sqft. available
body_markdown:
Covenant Logistics announced that its Forest Park, Georgia, distribution center has achieved active Foreign-Trade Zone (FTZ) status. The Atlanta-area FTZ warehouse gives importers and exporters a strategically located option to improve cash flow, manage duty exposure and increase supply chain flexibility.


The 401,242-square-foot Forest Park distribution center currently has up to 175,000 square feet available for occupancy. Located near Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport and major interstate and rail connections, the facility combines FTZ-enabled warehouse space with access to Covenant’s transportation and distribution network.


The FTZ activation expands Covenant’s distribution center management and warehousing capabilities for businesses managing imported goods. The activated facility operates under U.S. Customs and Border Protection oversight and may enable qualified customers to defer, reduce or eliminate certain duties until goods enter U.S. commerce.


> “Throughout the very dynamic trade environment over the last year and a half, we saw that we had a need to manage our imports and exports better,” said Emmet McNair, Director of Onboard Service Materials and Logistics at Delta Airlines. “Covenant was able to set up a Foreign-Trade Zone solution for us that helps mitigate import risk and enables us to use our inventory more efficiently.”


###### **Why Choose Covenant’s Forest Park FTZ Warehouse?**


Companies seeking Foreign-Trade Zone warehouse space in the Atlanta market can access flexible storage, rack and bulk storage, cross-docking, trailer parking, automated cycle-count technology and experienced warehouse operations support at the Forest Park facility.


The location is part of Covenant’s nationwide warehousing network, which spans more than 6 million square feet across the United States. By pairing FTZ capabilities with warehousing, transportation management and distribution services, Covenant helps customers manage international inventory within a broader end-to-end logistics strategy.


###### **Foreign-Trade Zone Warehouse Space Available Near Atlanta**


Covenant’s Forest Park FTZ warehouse is now accepting inquiries from importers, exporters, manufacturers and distributors evaluating FTZ strategies, distribution center outsourcing and Atlanta-area warehouse space. Up to 175,000 square feet is currently available within the 401,242-square-foot facility.


Contact an FTZ specialist


Covenant Logistics Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, offers a portfolio of transportation and logistics services to customers throughout the United States. Primary services include asset-based expedited and dedicated truckload capacity, as well as asset-light warehousing, transportation management and freight brokerage capabilities. In addition, Transport Enterprise Leasing is an affiliated company providing revenue equipment sales and leasing services to the trucking industry. Covenant’s Class A common stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “CVLG.”
